I'm going to rate this is two ways; 1. The object itself. It's a good design, good material quality, and it all fits together perfectly. Wasn't a problem to assemble. 2. The acceptance. Our chickens won't use it. It was in their shed first, they slept in it, shat in it and only occasionally used the bottom right box to lay an egg. I moved it outside where they had some old tyres and a Gitterbox (Wiremesh Container) full of firewood, where they love to lay eggs. I covered the tyres and box but the still didn't want to use this nesting box. I have now hung it outside their shed, protected from the elements in the hope that they'll accept it once it's aged a little.
